title: Trigger rubric optimization on every second human-label transition
description: Default rubric trigger counts class-to-class changes in either direction. First transition does not fire; second does. Repeated labels and skips do not count. Derive state from durable feedback for restart safety and omit retracted votes. Trace count, threshold, previous/current labels and causal linkage. Keep other optimization and fitting schedules separate; update operational replay preflight ceilings. Verify fake-client operational replay and unit specs; preserve old recordings.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Implemented reusable LabelTransitionTrigger and default every-two transition scheduling in the Rich reviewer and operational replay. Durable trigger checks include count and both labels; repeated checks do not refire, retractions are excluded, and restarts retain progress. Other stages and fitting keep independent vote cadences. Offline suite: 509 passed. Existing-label preflight: 87 items, 7 rubric rounds plus 4 separately scheduled context rounds; conservative ceilings 5829 decision requests and 11 optimizer calls. No new paid replay; prior browser recording unchanged.
